## 6. CI/CD

**`.github/workflows/test.yml`** — the gate. Triggers: push to `main`, and every `pull_request` (unfiltered). Runs on `runs-on: self-hosted-mac`, Node 24 with npm cache. Steps: emit runner stats to the job summary (host/cores/RAM — needed because a self-hosted runner's hardware isn't fixed), then `npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, each wrapped in `time-step.sh`. Sets `OPENAI_API_KEY: ci-dummy-key-network-is-mocked` because "the convex tests stub all network calls, but the OpenAI client asserts a key exists before the stubbed fetch is ever reached" (L38-40).

**`.github/workflows/ios.yml`** — path-filtered to `ios/**` and itself, on push-to-main and PRs. Its own workflow purely so it can be path-filtered ("macOS runners bill at roughly ten times the Linux rate"). `concurrency: group: ios-simulator, cancel-in-progress: false` — a fixed string, not `github.ref`, because there is one self-hosted Mac and one simulator, and two concurrent `xcodebuild test` runs kill each other during CoreSimulator bootstrap with an error that "reads exactly like a real failure and is not one" (cost two false reds on 2026-07-28). `timeout-minutes: 30`. Steps: `xcodebuild -version`, `brew install xcodegen`, `xcodegen generate` (the `.xcodeproj` is git-ignored), SPM cache keyed on `hashFiles('ios/project.yml')`, a jq-based runtime simulator picker (hardcoding a device name breaks on image bumps), then `xcodebuild test`. No `CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO` on purpose — an unsigned install crashes at launch for whoever next opens the simulator on the shared runner.

**`.github/workflows/clerk-config.yml`** — the **monitor**, explicitly "A monitor, not a gate" (L20-23). Triggers: `schedule: cron "0 7 * * *"` and `workflow_dispatch`. Deliberately not on `pull_request`: "a third party's configuration is not something a PR should be blocked on." Runs an inline heredoc Node script on `ubuntu-latest` that: reads `clerkProductionKey` out of `ios/Haven/Config.swift`, base64-decodes it to recover the Clerk frontend host ("Swap the key and this check follows it"), fetches `/v1/environment`, and fails if any of `sign_in_url`, `sign_up_url`, `home_url`, `after_sign_in_url`, `after_sign_up_url` points at an `accounts.` Account Portal (the production redirect loop), or if `application_name !== "Haven"`. The header comment documents why no in-repo test could ever see this class of bug. Its code-side twin is `src/clerkConfig.test.ts`.

**`.github/workflows/claude.yml`** — interactive bot on `issue_comment`, `pull_request_review_comment`, `pull_request_review`, `issues`, gated on `@claude` appearing in the body/title. `ubuntu-latest`, `anthropics/claude-code-action@v1` with `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`. Permissions: contents/PRs/issues write + `id-token: write`.

**`.github/workflows/time-step.sh`** — shared helper, wraps a CI command in BSD `/usr/bin/time -l` and appends wall time + peak RSS to `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`, preserving the wrapped command's exit code via `pipefail` + `PIPESTATUS`.

**Removed:** the daily auto-PR "one suggested improvement" bot, deleted in v0.43.1 / PR #211 ("It had been failing daily rather than proposing anything").

**Vercel deploy pipeline (`vercel.json`)** — answering the question directly: **yes, the production web build is what deploys Convex.**
- `buildCommand` (L2): `if [ "$VERCEL_ENV" = production ]; then npx convex deploy --cmd 'npm run build'; else : "${VITE_CONVEX_URL:?Preview builds no longer deploy Convex, so set VITE_CONVEX_URL for the Preview environment in Vercel}" && npm run build; fi`. Preview builds hard-fail with that message if the var is unset.
- `ignoreCommand` (L3): production never skips (`exit 1`); previews fetch `origin/main --depth=100` and skip the build unless the diff touches `src/ public/ index.html vite.config.ts vercel.json package.json package-lock.json`. This is the v0.37.0 fix — "of the last forty merges, thirty-three built a bundle that had not changed, and those builds were three quarters of the account's daily deployment budget."
- `framework: vite`, `outputDirectory: dist`.
- Headers: `apple-app-site-association` forced to `application/json`; a strict enforced CSP on everything *except* `demo-sky.html`, which gets its own looser policy (`script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'`, `X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN`) because it is a self-contained embedded artifact. The main CSP names two Convex deployments (`third-hound-186`, `brilliant-puma-925`), a third Convex site (`glorious-gerbil-332`, the feedback widget), both a dev Clerk host (`valued-bonefish-64.clerk.accounts.dev`) and prod (`clerk.inhavens.com`) — `todo.md:54` says the dev entries can come out once production sign-in is confirmed.
- SPA rewrite: `/((?!api/|assets/)[^.]+)` → `/index.html`.

**Test config (`vitest.config.ts`)** — `environment: "edge-runtime"`, `convex-test` inlined. Two documented hacks: `exclude` covers `**/.worktrees/**` and `**/.claude/worktrees/**` so nested dev worktrees' copies of test files don't run; and `convex/people.test.ts` + `convex/memories.test.ts` are split into a `convex-people-serial` project with `pool: "forks"`, `singleFork: true`, `sequence.groupOrder: 1` — they exercise a convex-test scheduler race where a starved retry timer can double-start the embed retry job under CPU contention, and mere isolation within a shared worker pool would not remove the contention.

---

## 7. Dependencies (`package.json`)

`name: haven-app`, `private: true`, `version: 0.48.0`, `type: module`. Scripts: `dev` (vite), `build` (`tsc -b && vite build`), `preview`, `test` (`vitest run`), `brand:assets` (`python3 scripts/generate-brand-assets.py`). `allowScripts` pins post-install script permission for `esbuild@0.27.0` and `fsevents@2.3.3`.

**Runtime deps (7):** `convex ^1.41.0` · `@clerk/react ^6.12.5` · `react ^19.0.0` / `react-dom ^19.0.0` · `stripe ^22.3.2` · `libphonenumber-js ^1.13.10` (**added in the working tree** — the v0.48.0 web-side phone normalization matching iOS) · `feedback-sdk-widget ^0.1.0` (admin-only, described as temporary in v0.42.0).

**Dev deps (11):** `vitest ^3.0.0` · `convex-test ^0.0.54` · `@edge-runtime/vm ^5.0.0` · `@testing-library/react ^16.3.2` · `happy-dom ^15.11.7` · `vite ^7.0.0` · `@vitejs/plugin-react ^5.0.0` · `typescript ^5.7.0` · `@types/node ^26.1.1` · `@types/react` / `@types/react-dom ^19.0.0`.

`grep -ri polygres`, excluding `node_modules`, `.claude`, `.git`, `.worktrees` — **9 files, 77 hits**:

It is not app code, not imported by any build, and not referenced by any config. **It is untracked in git** (`git ls-files people.md` → empty; `git check-ignore` → not ignored), so it shows as `??` and would be swept up by any `git add -A`. The download page's claims (`src/SkyPage.tsx:40-42`) are consistent with the tool's actual architecture: analysis on-Mac, messages never uploaded, Ollama optional and off by default.

Subtitle: "Remember the people you meet" (28 of 30 chars); rejected alternatives are recorded with reasons ("Your network, remembered" sells a network before there is one). The ~1100-char description leads with "You meet someone worth remembering. A week later you have their handle and nothing else," and the three pillars are Save them in seconds / It works with no signal / Find them by what you remember — the last of which advertises the `people.ask` bridge feature ("it tells you who could introduce you, and why"). Name reservation is flagged as the longest-lead item on the whole list.

**`scripts/` — 4 files, all out-of-band tooling.** `generate-brand-assets.py` + `requirements.txt` (the `npm run brand:assets` pipeline generating favicons, Apple touch, PWA icons and the OG card from `brand/nori.png`); `eval-ask.ts` (the ask-quality eval, deliberately outside CI, needs a live key); `dump-shared-fixtures.ts` (9.5KB — dumps TS vectors so the Swift sky generator can be asserted against them, per `todo.md:118`, "so the app and the future web card page cannot drift apart").

(a) *Backend conventions*: idempotent creation — a mutation creating something uniquely identifiable dedups on its key and returns an explicit outcome (`{ status: "joined" | "already" }`); check-and-insert stay in the same mutation since Convex mutations are transactional; "Do not build a shared 'uniqueness engine'"; key on the field that is actually unique (email), not an incidental one (name). Scope: every non-generated file under `convex/` as it exists uncommitted. `convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md` exists (458 lines, Convex `^1.41.0` guidelines) and was read only far enough to confirm it is the vendored ruleset the source comments cite; `_generated/*` otherwise skipped. ## 3. MEMORY / CAPTURE PIPELINE

**Ingest → person.** `createCapture` (`captures.ts:224-248`) validates the blob, inserts `pending`, and schedules `internal.captures.extract` at delay 0. `extract` (`301-332`) resolves a signed storage URL and calls `extractProfile` (`openaiClient.ts:154-214`) — this is the **only LLM extraction** in the pipeline. Success → `finishExtract` sets `ready`+`extracted`; failure → `failExtract` splits user-safe vs raw text. There is **no LLM summarization** anywhere; `context` is stored verbatim.

**Triage.** `acceptCapture` `370-455` (model-extracted, lenient, handle source `"imported"` `393-395`) and `acceptManualCapture` `462-564` (human-typed, strict, source `"typed"` `506-513`) both run `tryAttachToOwner` `109-194` first: if the handle already has an owner, fill-if-empty (`fillEmptyFields:78-99`), append the note, merge the handle, rewrite the index, `syncMemories`, schedule embed, delete the capture. Only on `null` do they create.

**Memories.** `syncMemories` (`memories.ts:52-88`) splits `context` on newlines `38-46`, dedupes against the existing ≤200 rows, inserts, and schedules `internal.memories.embed` **per line**. Called from `addPersonCore:871`, `attachToExistingPerson:669`, `updatePerson:1303`, `editPerson:1522`, `saveSharedProfile:1729,1811,1848`, `tryAttachToOwner:177`, `acceptCapture:445`, `acceptManualCapture:554`. `ensureMeetPerson` deliberately writes none `396-398`.

**Embeddings.** Provider: OpenAI `embeddings` endpoint, model `text-embedding-3-small`, 1536-dim (`openaiClient.ts:318-329`), deliberately **not** provider-swappable `96-98`. Person text is `buildEmbedText` (`src/lib.ts:319-350`) sliced to 8000 chars (`people.ts:1970-1980`); memory text is the line itself, sliced to 8000 (`memories.ts:148-150`). Vector indexes: `people.by_embedding` (`schema.ts:100-104`) and `memories.by_embedding` (`125-129`), both `filterFields:["userId"]`.

**Retry/idempotency.** Both `embed` actions retry on `[30_000, 300_000]` ms (`people.ts:81`, `memories.ts:21`) and then log-and-return rather than throw (`people.ts:2002-2010`, `memories.ts:170-180`). Idempotent via stored `embeddedText`.

**Scheduler use.** `ctx.scheduler.runAfter` appears at: `captures.ts:245,183,452,561,602`; `people.ts:675,877,1309,1528,1735,1817,1849,2011`; `memories.ts:86,181`; `profiles.ts:346,412,511,516,665,811`; `waitlist.ts:66`. All model traffic is plain `fetch` against OpenAI-compatible `/v1/...` (`openaiClient.ts:132-152`); no SDK, no `"use node"`.

**Env var names only** (never values): `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_BASE_URL` (`openaiClient.ts:86-92`); `EXTRACTION_BASE_URL`/`EXTRACTION_API_KEY`/`EXTRACTION_MODEL` and `ASK_BASE_URL`/`ASK_API_KEY`/`ASK_MODEL` via the `chatConfig` prefix scheme `99-130` (a custom base URL **must** bring its own key and model `112-118`); `CLERK_JWT_ISSUER_DOMAIN` (`auth.config.ts:9`); `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (`http.ts:12,116`); `RESEND_API_KEY`, `WAITLIST_FROM_EMAIL` (`emailClient.ts:83-84`); `COMPOSIO_API_KEY` (`composio.ts:98,787`). **Extraction prompt** (`openaiClient.ts:60-72`), verbatim:
> "This is a screenshot the user took of someone's social or professional profile. Identify which platform it is from (branding, layout, UI chrome) and extract the person's visible details. Only report what is actually visible; never guess a handle or invent text. If the image is not a person's profile, set is_profile to false. A field this platform does not have is null. Prefer null to a near miss."

Structured output: strict `json_schema` named `profile_extraction` `174-181`, schema `EXTRACTION_SCHEMA:28-58` (all six properties `required`, optionality as nullable types, platform enum `14-24`). Image sent with `detail: "low"` — cost rationale documented `166-170`. Post-parse gate: `!is_profile || name === ""` throws `"Could not read a profile in this screenshot"` `199-202` (one of the two allowlisted user-safe messages, `captures.ts:277-280`).

**Ask prompt** (`openaiClient.ts:263-276`), verbatim:
> "You are searching one person's private notes about people they know. / Each entry below is one person: a #number, their details, and dated lines the user wrote about them. / Answer only from these entries. Never invent a person, a fact, or a #number. / Return a match as 'direct' when the person themselves fits the need. / Return 'bridge' when nobody fits directly but this person is a plausible route to someone who does (for example: they work at a startup accelerator, so they likely know founders). / A bridge must never be dressed up as a direct match, and its 'why' must say what the route is. / If the request is too vague to answer without guessing, return no matches and ask exactly one clarifying question. Otherwise leave clarifying_question null. / Order matches best first, and leave matches empty rather than padding it with weak ones."

Structured output: strict `json_schema` named `network_answer`, schema `ASK_SCHEMA:225-261`. Message assembly: system prompt, then `The network:\n\n${dossiers}`, then prior turns, then the query `289-293`. Server-side validation of the model's answer (`people.ts:2541-2571`): unknown ref, repeat ref, or off-schema `kind` is dropped; matches capped at `MAX_ASK_MATCHES = 10` `2211`.

**Cost/rate limiting.** `rateLimit.ts:14-55` fixed-window; complete table: `createCapture` 10/min + 100/day (`captures.ts:231-232`), `retryExtract` 10/min + 100/day (`588-589`), `acceptManual` 30/min (`480`), `addPerson` 30/min (`people.ts:724`), `updatePerson`/`editPerson` 60/min (`1283`,`1344`), `saveSharedProfile` 30/min (`1622`), `semanticSearch` 30/min (`2089-2094`), `ask` 10/min + 100/day (`2479-2490`), `profiles:generateUploadUrl` 10/min (`profiles.ts:574-580`), `recordOnboardingStep` 60/min (`599`), `setUsername`/`claimHandle` 10/min (`835`,`1001`), `updateMyProfile` 60/min (`893`), `connect`/`disconnect` 20/min (`1100`,`1198`), `updateSharedNote` 60/min (`sharedNotes.ts:105`), `loveAlarm:startPresence` 20/min, `loveAlarm:heartbeat` 120/min (`loveAlarm.ts:55,93`), `initiateSocialConnection` 10/min (`composio.ts:463-468`), `completeSocialConnection` 40/min (sized for a 2s iOS poll, `520-532`), `resolveXPlatformId:minute`/`resolveXUsername:minute` 10/min each plus **shared** `xLookup:day` 50/day (`composio.ts:590`, `674-685`, `734-745`), `joinWaitlist` 40/min **globally** (`waitlist.ts:14-16`).

---

## 6. EXTERNAL INTEGRATIONS

**Composio** (`composio.ts`, REST v3 at `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3` `31`, pinned against the OpenAPI doc `13-18`). Platform↔toolkit map `TOOLKIT_SLUG:50-54` (`x` → `twitter`). Actions executed: `LINKEDIN_GET_MY_INFO`, `INSTAGRAM_GET_USER_INFO`, `TWITTER_USER_LOOKUP_ME` (`PROFILE_TOOL:62-66`), `TWITTER_USER_LOOKUP_BY_USERNAME` (`73`). Endpoints touched: `GET /auth_configs`, `POST /auth_configs` `194-211`, `GET /connected_accounts` `473-475`, `552-554`, `614-616`, `796-798`, `POST /connected_accounts/link` `494-497`, `POST /tools/execute/{tool}` `381-391`, `634-644`, `DELETE /connected_accounts/{id}?revoke_on_delete=true` `809-812` (the flag is load-bearing — without it Composio soft-deletes and leaves OAuth live `763-769`). Extractors: `extractHandle:269-295`, `extractPlatformId:305-331`, `extractPhotoUrl:338-363`. Result is written to the card as `verified:true` + `platformId` via `storeVerifiedHandle:417-441`, which merges rather than replaces. Instagram personal-account failure is string-matched into `unsupported_account` `255-263`. Error bodies truncated at 500 chars before being thrown `113-128`. **Partially implemented / unproven:** X's response shape and `TOOL_ARGUMENTS.x = {user_fields:"profile_image_url"}` are inferred, not live-proven `58-66`, `76-84`.

**Stripe** — webhook only (§7); no outbound API calls (`http.ts:7-14` constructs the client with a placeholder key purely for `stripe.webhooks`). Entitlement policy `stripeFields.ts:30-38`: `trialing`/`active`/`past_due` grant access, with `past_due` justified by Smart Retries `26-29`. `hasProAccess` ORs across rows `stripe.ts:80-82`.

**Clerk** — `auth.config.ts:18-27`, provider domain from `CLERK_JWT_ISSUER_DOMAIN` (throws at import if unset `8-16`), `applicationID: "convex"` must match the JWT template `23-25`. No Clerk webhook, no user-sync function anywhere.

**Resend** — `emailClient.ts:79-113`, `POST https://api.resend.com/emails`; returns `{status:"skipped"}` when either credential is unset `87-92`; HTML-escapes the untrusted name `10-17`.

---

## 7. HTTP ROUTES (`convex/http.ts`)

Exactly one route: `POST /stripe/webhook` `112-179`. Order of checks: missing secret → **500, fail closed** `116-122`; missing `stripe-signature` → 400 `124-127`; raw body read before parsing so the signed bytes are preserved `129-131`; `constructEventAsync` with `Stripe.createSubtleCryptoProvider()` (V8 runtime requirement `7-15`) → 400 on forgery/tamper/replay-window `133-147`; unhandled event type → **200** to avoid Stripe retry loops `149-153`; malformed payload → logged + **200** (permanent failure, no retry can fix `156-165`). Handled events: `customer.subscription.created|updated|deleted` `22-26`. `parseSubscription:56-108` re-validates every field despite the signature `54-55`, reads `clerkUserId` from `subscription.metadata` (not customer metadata `76-83`), and reads `current_period_end` off the subscription **item** for API version 2026-06-24 `85-98` (falls back to `0` with a loud log rather than dropping the event).

---

## 8. CRONS (`convex/crons.ts:1-53`)

| name | interval | target |
|---|---|---|
| `embed backfill` `8-13` | 24h | `internal.people.backfillEmbeddings` |
| `memory embed backfill` `17-22` | 24h | `internal.memories.backfillMemoryEmbeddings` |
| `sweep stuck captures` `26-31` | 30min | `internal.captures.sweepStuckCaptures` |
| `sweep orphaned uploads` `36-41` | 24h | `internal.captures.sweepOrphanedUploads` |
| `sweep expired presence` `46-51` | 30min | `internal.loveAlarm.sweepExpiredPresence` |

`crons.ts:35` records the maintenance obligation: any new table storing a storage id must be added to `sweepOrphanedUploads` or its files get deleted.

---

## 9. TESTS

Harness: `convex-test` + `vitest` on `edge-runtime` (`vitest.config.ts:29-31`). ~440 test cases across 16 files. Coverage by file:

- **`people.test.ts` (3615 lines, ~127 cases)** — deepest suite: auth/ownership on every mutation `275-283`, `585-604`, `781-804`, `2740-2746`; leak check that `embedding`/`embeddedText`/`userId` never surface `805-832`; the whole identity/dedup matrix (`441`, `477`, `522`, `556`, `605`, `1387`, `1446`, `1502`, `1543`, `1606`, `3469`, `3519`, `3576`); the legacy `addPerson` contract `328-440`; all five backfills; `reportDuplicateHandleOwners` incl. page-split groups `3351`; field caps `3399`, `3442`.
- **`captures.test.ts` (~62)** — full pipeline incl. error-text leakage `565-600`, both sweeps incl. watermark reset `1661`, attach-to-owner paths `1301-1560`, cross-user refusal `320`, `921`.
- **`profiles.test.ts` (~80)** — card CRUD, handle ladder, `getByHandle` public shape incl. the phone-exclusion proof `1014-1035`, `deleteMyAccount` (`554`, `610`, `642`, `1391`, `1844`), connect/disconnect/freeze/thaw, snapshot fan-out past page 1 `1520`.
- **`composio.test.ts` (~41)** — the cross-user `connectedAccountId` guard incl. the "no `user_id` field at all" case `284-314`, per-platform id/photo extraction, unsupported-account matching, shared daily cap `1121`, account-deletion cleanup tolerance `1166-1265`.
- **`memories.test.ts` (~18)**, **`ask.test.ts` (~13, uses `src/askFixtures`)**, **`sharedNotes.test.ts` (5)**, **`stripe.test.ts` (19, real `Stripe` signing incl. forged/replayed/stale/missing-secret)**, **`waitlist.test.ts` (6)**, **`loveAlarm.test.ts` (5)**, **`rateLimit.test.ts` (4)**, **`crons.test.ts` (1 — every cron target resolves)**, **`openaiClient.test.ts` (8 — provider-routing env matrix)**, **`handleKeys.test.ts` (26)**, **`handleNames.test.ts` (6)**, **`emailClient.test.ts` (9)**, **`auth.config.test.ts` (4)**.

**Known-flaky area — confirmed in-repo, with mitigation.** `vitest.config.ts:14-16,22-49` puts `convex/people.test.ts` and `convex/memories.test.ts` into their own project with `pool:"forks"`, `singleFork:true`, `sequence.groupOrder:1`, because "These files exercise a convex-test scheduler race (a starved retry timer can double-start the embed retry job) that only shows up under CPU contention from other files running at the same time." The affected assertions are the embed-retry attempt counts (`people.test.ts:1132-1175`, `memories.test.ts:365-382`). Flakiness is contained, not open.

**Notable gaps.** No test file for `http.ts` routing itself (the webhook is exercised through `stripe.test.ts`, which posts to the handler); no direct tests for `authz.ts`, `imageBlobs.ts`, `fieldCaps.ts`, `nameSearch.ts`, `connections.ts`, `profileFields.ts`, `stripeFields.ts` beyond indirect coverage (`nameSearch` gets a `describe("normalizeName")` at `people.test.ts:923-943`; `grantsProAccess` at `stripe.test.ts:92-107`); no test asserting the `embed backfill` cron heals a person outside the first 200 rows (see F1); no test for `people.directoryFacets` beyond one happy path `2154`; no test for `loveAlarm.stopPresence` idempotency; `people.test.ts:2139` notes convex-test crashes iterating a search index, forcing one test to skip a pre-backfill query.

---

## 10. TODO / STUB / PARTIAL / DEAD CODE

No literal `TODO`/`FIXME`/`HACK`/`@ts-ignore` exists anywhere in `convex/` (grep across all non-generated `.ts`). What exists instead is prose-marked future work and a small number of behavioral gaps.

**Planned, not implemented (explicit):**
- `handleSourceValidator` member `"guessed"` — `peopleFields.ts:13-18`, comment at `12`: "reserved for the rename-proof-links work this brief lays the groundwork for and **nothing writes it yet**." Confirmed: no writer.
- `subscriptions.source` is `v.literal("stripe")`; `"app_store"` is named as future work for the iOS tier — `schema.ts:324-328`.
- `connections` table comment describes a "future mutual-link flow" with explicit both-side consent — `schema.ts:161-163`; what ships is one-tap `connect` `profiles.ts:1076-1078`.
- Per-field connection sharing ("selective card sharing") is explicitly post-v1 — `people.ts:1193-1194`.
- `MIN_SEMANTIC_SCORE = 0.3` is flagged as due recalibration against a "wave B evaluation set" — `people.ts:45-49`.
- `reportDuplicateHandleOwners` exists to inform a "wave C reconciliation"; the file states `saveSharedProfile` can only move from `.first()` to `.unique()` once it reports zero — `people.ts:2823-2830`.
- `personHandles.by_user_and_platform_and_platformId` ships **unstaged** deliberately, with the upgrade condition written down — `schema.ts:151-159`.
- Composio X support is unproven against a live connection — `composio.ts:58-66`, `76-84`.
- `people.directoryFacets` counts go approximate past 1000 rows, with the upgrade path named — `people.ts:1125-1130`.
- `memories.listMissingMemoryEmbeddings` names its own upgrade path (a `sweepState` cursor) — `memories.ts:190-193`.

**Findings (audit observations, ranked):**

**F1 — `people.listMissingEmbeddings` walls the daily embed cron.** `people.ts:2578-2587` does `ctx.db.query("people").take(200)` and filters `embedding === undefined` **in JS**. Compare `memories.listMissingMemoryEmbeddings` (`memories.ts:194-204`), which pushes the predicate into `.filter((q) => q.eq(q.field("embedding"), undefined)).take(200)`. Consequence: once the first 200 rows in default table order all carry embeddings, the `embed backfill` cron (`crons.ts:8-13`) returns 0 forever, and an unembedded person beyond that window stays permanently invisible to `semanticSearch` (`people.ts:2105-2109`) and `rankPeopleForAsk` (`2381-2385`). The comment calling `backfillEmbeddings` a self-heal (`crons.ts:4-5`, `people.ts:2576-2577`) does not hold past 200 rows. Same JS-filter shape in `backfillSearchText` `2620-2623` and `backfillNormalizedNames` `2935-2938`, but those are documented one-off manual runs (`2613-2615`, `2927-2930`), so the failure mode there is "returns 0 and looks done" rather than a silently dead cron.

**F2 — `memories` has no owner-scoped index.** `schema.ts:124-129` defines only `by_person` and the vector index. Deletion is therefore reachable only through the person row (`memories.ts:97-100`, `profiles.ts:698-721`). Any memory row whose `personId` no longer resolves is unreachable by `deleteMemories`, by `purgeOwnedRows`, and by every query. (Whether such a row is producible today is not traced here; the structural property is the finding.)

**F3 — `captures.generateUploadUrl` is unrate-limited.** `captures.ts:215-222` mints a storage upload URL for any signed-in caller with no `checkRateLimit`, while the sibling `profiles.generateUploadUrl` (`profiles.ts:569-583`) caps at 10/min with the rationale written out at `566-568` ("a URL is a write into storage… a sweep is a cleanup, not a cap"). The orphan sweep reclaims the blobs, but only after ≥1h (`captures.ts:655`).

**F4 — `acceptCapture` schedules a paid embed with no rate limit.** `captures.ts:370-455` has no `checkRateLimit`, while `acceptManualCapture` adds `acceptManual` 30/min with the comment "Naming schedules a paid embedding, so guard the burst like the other spend paths do" (`478-480`). `createCapture` bounds how many captures exist, but a caller can accept the same budget of captures at unbounded rate.

**F5 — `waitlist`'s global bucket is a trivially achievable denial of signup.** `waitlist.ts:14-16` uses a single sentinel row `"public:waitlist"` at 40/min for all callers. The comment frames the tradeoff as "a genuine burst past the cap is briefly turned away" (`10-13`); the sharper reading is that one attacker exhausts the window and every legitimate signup in the remainder of that minute is refused. Documented tradeoff, correctly scoped to a private-beta waitlist — not an accident.

**F6 — three internal queries omit `returns` validators**, against the vendored guidelines: `captures.getCapture` `250-255`, `people.getPersonInternal` `1861-1866`, `people.fetchSearchResults` `2040-2064`. Every other function in the codebase declares one.

**F7 — error-type inconsistency.** Only `waitlist.ts:45,50` throws `ConvexError`; every other throw in `convex/` is a bare `Error` (e.g. `people.ts:727`, `profiles.ts:939`, `sharedNotes.ts:109`, `rateLimit.ts:49`), which reaches clients as an "Uncaught Error" rather than structured application data.

**Dead/disabled code:** none found. The nearest thing is `saveSharedProfile`'s `merged !== null && merged.status !== "refused"` branch, which the file itself documents as "provably unreachable today… kept as a defensive fallback" (`people.ts:1779-1787`), and `oldestLiveOwner`'s cross-tenant row check, documented as a belt for a hypothetical future caller (`people.ts:363-375`).

---

## 11. ACCOUNT DELETION / DATA EXPORT

**Deletion: implemented.** `profiles.deleteMyAccount` `profiles.ts:645-672` — deletes the profile photo blob and the profile row first (so the public address stops resolving immediately `636-637`), then `purgeOwnedRows`, then schedules `internal.composio.deleteConnectedAccountsForUser` (a mutation cannot reach the network `658-664`). Idempotent by design `639-641`. `purgeOwnedRows:695-815` walks, at `PURGE_PAGE = 200` per table per transaction: `people` (+ screenshot blob, photo blob, all `personHandles`, all memories) `698-722`; `captures` (+ blobs) `724-732`; rows in *other* users' directories that referenced this account, collapsed to a frozen snapshot by clearing `havenContactUserId` and stamping `connectionEndedAt` `739-751`; both sides of `connections` plus their `sharedNotes` `757-779`; `loveAlarmPresence` `783-790`; `rateLimits` **last**, so the purge cannot lift its own caps `799-808`. Reschedules itself while any table is still full `810-814`; the continuation `purgeAccountData:680-690` aborts if a profile row reappeared. `subscriptions` is the **one table deliberately not purged**, rationale at `792-797` (billing record, answers refunds/chargebacks, keyed to a Stripe customer). Other users' private notes about the caller are deliberately untouched `642-644`.

**Export: not implemented.** There is no export function anywhere in `convex/` — no query returning a user's full dataset, no admin/dump/backup function, and no HTTP route besides `POST /stripe/webhook` (`http.ts:110-181`). The closest reads are `listPeople` (one page, `people.ts:1003-1020`) and `listPersonNames` (names + handles only, 2000-row cap, `951-973`).

---

## 12. MULTI-TENANCY

**Isolation model.** Every owned table carries `userId: string` = Clerk `tokenIdentifier`, and every owner-scoped read goes through an index whose leading key is `userId` (`schema.ts:74`, `146-150`, `207`, `225`, `265`, `281-282`, `344`). Both vector indexes carry `filterFields:["userId"]` (`100-104`, `125-129`), and both search indexes filter on it (`92-99`). Direct `db.get` on a client-supplied id is always followed by an ownership comparison: `people.ts:1267`, `1285`, `1346`, `1549`, `1759`, `1891`, `2266`; `captures.ts:380`, `483`, `572`, `591`; `sharedNotes.ts:29`; `profiles.ts:1200`. Reads return `null` for a foreign row (`getPerson:1266-1269`) while writes throw `"Person not found"` / `"Capture not found"` — deliberately indistinguishable from "does not exist."

**Explicit cross-tenant guards.** `oldestLiveOwner` skips a `personHandles` row whose own `userId` mismatches **and** one whose `personId` resolves to another tenant's person, logging both with the handle value redacted (`people.ts:363-391`); it also self-heals orphan index rows `376-383`. `listAskMemories` re-checks `memory.userId` even though the ids came from an owner-filtered index `2323-2325`. `listNetworkForAsk` re-checks `person.userId` on the id path `2261-2269`. `patchXPlatformId` re-checks ownership at write time because two network calls elapse between the action's check and the write `1874-1880`, `1891`. `completeSocialConnection` refuses to trust `connected_accounts.user_id` (Composio documents its removal) and instead requires the id to appear in the caller's own server-scoped list `composio.ts:534-561`.

**Legitimate cross-tenant write paths (by design):**
1. `profiles.connect` `1090-1179` calls `ensureMeetPerson` for **both** sides `1119-1130`, inserting a `people` row + a `personHandles` row into the **peer's** directory and scheduling an embed charged against the deployment — with no accept step, because "connecting in person is the consent" `1076-1078`. Rate-limited at 20/min on the initiator (`1100`); the peer has no throttle of their own on rows created this way.
2. `profiles.updateMyProfile` fans out `snapshotPatch` into every other user's row that references the caller `985-987`, `487-522` (`by_havenContactUserId`, `schema.ts:78-82`).
3. `profiles.deleteMyAccount` patches other users' rows to freeze them `739-751`.
4. `people.projectConnectedPerson` `1220-1259` reads the peer's `profiles` row on the detail read and merges name/city/company/role/handles/photo, deliberately withholding nothing between connected users `1185-1194`.

**Public / unauthenticated exposure paths:**
- `profiles.getByHandle` `1040-1054` — any visitor with a handle gets `{handle, name, photoUrl, city, handles, primaryPlatform}`. Phone is excluded *structurally*: `publicHandleValidator` (`profileFields.ts:35-43`) has no `phone` member, so Convex's own return validation would reject a leak, and `toPublicHandles:279-283` filters it out anyway. City is returned as `cityInputValidator`, dropping the private `normalized` filter key `82-84`. A legacy row with no name returns `null` `286-290`. Enumerable: handles are 3-24 chars of `[a-z0-9_]` (`handleNames.ts:16`) and there is **no rate limit** on this query.
- `waitlist.joinWaitlist` `25-72` — unauthenticated write; never reveals whether an address was seen before ("already" is a success `22-24`).
- `stripe.hasProAccess` `67-84` — callable signed out, returns `false`.
- `loveAlarm.nearby` `132-158` — authenticated but **not tenant-scoped**: any signed-in user who knows or guesses a `roomCode` (3-32 chars of `[A-Z0-9-]`, `loveAlarm.ts:12`) receives every active peer's `displayName` and `lastSeenAt` in that room, capped at 40 (`9`, `142-157`). The caller is filtered out of their own list `153`. This is the intended opt-in proximity semantic (`schema.ts:272-273`, `loveAlarm.ts:196-204`), and the only protection is shared knowledge of the code — no membership check, and `startPresence` will join any well-formed room.

**Server-side-only fields, verified never projected:** `people.embedding`/`embeddedText`/`userId` (excluded from `personValidator:98-124`, tested at `people.test.ts:805-832`); `people.havenContactUserId` (peer's Clerk key, withheld `118-121`); `profiles.userId` (`profiles.ts:50-51`); `captures.errorDetail` (`schema.ts:203-205`, projected out at `captures.ts:358-366`, tested at `captures.test.ts:565-600`); `profiles.city.normalized` (`profiles.ts:82-84`).

# Convex Backend Audit — Haven (`euno-app`), working tree on `feat/identity-foundation`

Scope: every non-generated file under `convex/` as it exists uncommitted. `convex/_generated/ai/guidelines.md` exists (458 lines, Convex `^1.41.0` guidelines) and was read only far enough to confirm it is the vendored ruleset the source comments cite; `_generated/*` otherwise skipped. Uncommitted churn is concentrated in `people.ts` (+1013), `captures.ts` (+254), `composio.ts` (+222), `handleKeys.ts` (+84), with new exports `addPersonWithOutcome`, `listPersonNames`, `patchXPlatformId`, `backfillPhoneHandleKeys`, `resolveXPlatformId`, `resolveXUsername` (`git diff --stat -- convex/`).

Files: 24 source + 16 test. Auth helper `requireUser` at `convex/authz.ts:9-17` returns `identity.tokenIdentifier` ("issuer|subject") and throws `"Not signed in"` on null; there is **no local users table** — `userId: v.string()` on every owned row is that token.

---

## 1. FUNCTION INVENTORY (84 registered functions)

Legend: **A** = calls `requireUser` (throws if signed out). **A?** = calls `ctx.auth.getUserIdentity()` directly, tolerates null. **—** = no auth check (internal or deliberately public).

### convex/captures.ts

| fn | kind | auth | args | reads/writes | returns | errors |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `generateUploadUrl` `215-222` | mutation | **A** `219` | `{}` | `ctx.storage.generateUploadUrl()` | `v.string()` | — **no rate limit** (contrast `profiles.generateUploadUrl:569-583`, 10/min) |
| `createCapture` `224-248` | mutation | **A** `228` | `{screenshotId}` | validates blob `234-238`; inserts `captures` status `"pending"` `240-244`; `scheduler.runAfter(0, internal.captures.extract)` `245` | `v.id("captures")` | throws on non-image/>10MB via `imageBlobs.requireImageBlob:16-30`; RL 10/min + 100/day `231-232` |
| `getCapture` `250-255` | internalQuery | — | `{captureId}` | `db.get` | **no `returns` validator** | — |
| `finishExtract` `257-271` | internalMutation | — | `{captureId, extracted}` | patch `status:"ready"` | `v.null()` | null-guards a discarded row `261-263` |
| `failExtract` `283-299` | internalMutation | — | `{captureId, error}` | patch `status:"failed"`; splits safe vs raw text into `error`/`errorDetail` `291-296` | `v.null()` | allowlist `SAFE_ERROR_MESSAGES:277-280`, generic otherwise `281` |

## 3. MEMORY / CAPTURE PIPELINE

**Ingest → person.** `createCapture` (`captures.ts:224-248`) validates the blob, inserts `pending`, and schedules `internal.captures.extract` at delay 0. `extract` (`301-332`) resolves a signed storage URL and calls `extractProfile` (`openaiClient.ts:154-214`) — this is the **only LLM extraction** in the pipeline. Success → `finishExtract` sets `ready`+`extracted`; failure → `failExtract` splits user-safe vs raw text. There is **no LLM summarization** anywhere; `context` is stored verbatim.

**Triage.** `acceptCapture` `370-455` (model-extracted, lenient, handle source `"imported"` `393-395`) and `acceptManualCapture` `462-564` (human-typed, strict, source `"typed"` `506-513`) both run `tryAttachToOwner` `109-194` first: if the handle already has an owner, fill-if-empty (`fillEmptyFields:78-99`), append the note, merge the handle, rewrite the index, `syncMemories`, schedule embed, delete the capture. Only on `null` do they create.

**Memories.** `syncMemories` (`memories.ts:52-88`) splits `context` on newlines `38-46`, dedupes against the existing ≤200 rows, inserts, and schedules `internal.memories.embed` **per line**. Called from `addPersonCore:871`, `attachToExistingPerson:669`, `updatePerson:1303`, `editPerson:1522`, `saveSharedProfile:1729,1811,1848`, `tryAttachToOwner:177`, `acceptCapture:445`, `acceptManualCapture:554`. `ensureMeetPerson` deliberately writes none `396-398`.

**Embeddings.** Provider: OpenAI `embeddings` endpoint, model `text-embedding-3-small`, 1536-dim (`openaiClient.ts:318-329`), deliberately **not** provider-swappable `96-98`. Person text is `buildEmbedText` (`src/lib.ts:319-350`) sliced to 8000 chars (`people.ts:1970-1980`); memory text is the line itself, sliced to 8000 (`memories.ts:148-150`). Vector indexes: `people.by_embedding` (`schema.ts:100-104`) and `memories.by_embedding` (`125-129`), both `filterFields:["userId"]`.

**Retry/idempotency.** Both `embed` actions retry on `[30_000, 300_000]` ms (`people.ts:81`, `memories.ts:21`) and then log-and-return rather than throw (`people.ts:2002-2010`, `memories.ts:170-180`). Idempotent via stored `embeddedText`.

**Scheduler use.** `ctx.scheduler.runAfter` appears at: `captures.ts:245,183,452,561,602`; `people.ts:675,877,1309,1528,1735,1817,1849,2011`; `memories.ts:86,181`; `profiles.ts:346,412,511,516,665,811`; `waitlist.ts:66`. All model traffic is plain `fetch` against OpenAI-compatible `/v1/...` (`openaiClient.ts:132-152`); no SDK, no `"use node"`.

**Env var names only** (never values): `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_BASE_URL` (`openaiClient.ts:86-92`); `EXTRACTION_BASE_URL`/`EXTRACTION_API_KEY`/`EXTRACTION_MODEL` and `ASK_BASE_URL`/`ASK_API_KEY`/`ASK_MODEL` via the `chatConfig` prefix scheme `99-130` (a custom base URL **must** bring its own key and model `112-118`); `CLERK_JWT_ISSUER_DOMAIN` (`auth.config.ts:9`); `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY`, `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (`http.ts:12,116`); `RESEND_API_KEY`, `WAITLIST_FROM_EMAIL` (`emailClient.ts:83-84`); `COMPOSIO_API_KEY` (`composio.ts:98,787`). **Extraction prompt** (`openaiClient.ts:60-72`), verbatim:
> "This is a screenshot the user took of someone's social or professional profile. Identify which platform it is from (branding, layout, UI chrome) and extract the person's visible details. Only report what is actually visible; never guess a handle or invent text. If the image is not a person's profile, set is_profile to false. A field this platform does not have is null. Prefer null to a near miss."

Structured output: strict `json_schema` named `profile_extraction` `174-181`, schema `EXTRACTION_SCHEMA:28-58` (all six properties `required`, optionality as nullable types, platform enum `14-24`). Image sent with `detail: "low"` — cost rationale documented `166-170`. Post-parse gate: `!is_profile || name === ""` throws `"Could not read a profile in this screenshot"` `199-202` (one of the two allowlisted user-safe messages, `captures.ts:277-280`).

**Ask prompt** (`openaiClient.ts:263-276`), verbatim:
> "You are searching one person's private notes about people they know. / Each entry below is one person: a #number, their details, and dated lines the user wrote about them. / Answer only from these entries. Never invent a person, a fact, or a #number. / Return a match as 'direct' when the person themselves fits the need. / Return 'bridge' when nobody fits directly but this person is a plausible route to someone who does (for example: they work at a startup accelerator, so they likely know founders). / A bridge must never be dressed up as a direct match, and its 'why' must say what the route is. / If the request is too vague to answer without guessing, return no matches and ask exactly one clarifying question. Otherwise leave clarifying_question null. / Order matches best first, and leave matches empty rather than padding it with weak ones."

Structured output: strict `json_schema` named `network_answer`, schema `ASK_SCHEMA:225-261`. ## 3. SEARCH ON WEB

**Three genuinely distinct mechanisms, all live. It is not "only exact/fuzzy name matching."**

**(a) Server text search** — `useQuery(api.people.searchPeople,{query})`. Server (`convex/people.ts:975-998`) folds via `normalizeName`, then `withSearchIndex("search_normalized_name")` scoped by `userId`, capped at `RESULT_LIMIT` (20). Empty/punctuation-only queries fall back to the recent list.

**(b) Client-side typo matching** — `src/nameSuggestion.ts` (**untracked / new**).
- `levenshtein` (`:25-47`): classic (not Damerau), two-row DP, iterates **Unicode code points** via `Array.from` so astral characters count once.
- `MINIMUM_FUZZY_LENGTH = 4` (`:56`); `distanceLimit` (`:62-66`): `<4` → 0 (exact only), `<8` → 1, else 2. Rationale given: at 2-3 letters a distance of 1-2 reaches nearly every other short name.
- `nameSuggestions` (`:86-122`): exact matches first, then close; early-exits on length difference (Levenshtein ≥ |Δlen|); returns ≤5. Shares `normalizeName` with `convex/nameSearch.ts`, so "close" means the same fold the search index and `personHandles` use.

**Verdict on "typo suggestions reportedly non-functional against the real backend":** that describes the **pre-diff state, where the web suggester did not exist at all**. In the working tree it is **implemented and functional**. Evidence chain:
1. `nameSuggestion.ts` is untracked → brand new.
2. `git diff src/SearchAdd.tsx` shows the suggester, the `suggestionPool` query, `attachTo` state, and `addPerson` switching from `api.people.addPerson` → `api.people.addPersonWithOutcome`, all added in this diff.
3. The backing query **exists and is registered**: `convex/people.ts:951-973`, returning `{_id, name, contactHandles}` per person — so `disambiguator` (`SearchAdd.tsx:111-119`) has real data.
4. `CHANGELOG.md` v0.48.0 → **Web** bullet 1 describes exactly this shipping.

Two real caveats worth recording:
- **Scale ceiling, documented as such:** `SUGGESTION_POOL_LIMIT = 2000` with `.take()` (`convex/people.ts:943, 966`). Above 2000 people the pool truncates silently; the comment names pagination as the fix. Design choice, not a defect.
- **Stale docstring, same-commit contradiction:** `nameSuggestion.ts:83-85` says *"SearchAdd passes the live name-search results, not a full directory scan, so a person the server's own search index does not surface for this query cannot be suggested here either."* That is flatly contradicted by `SearchAdd.tsx:167` and by SearchAdd's own comment at `:161-166`, which explain that using `nameMatches` was precisely the bug (S7) and that `listPersonNames` replaced it. A reader taking the docstring at face value would conclude the S7 fix isn't there.

**(c) Real semantic / natural-language search** — yes, it exists on web and it is not mocked.
Client (`SearchAdd.tsx:175, 199-218`): `useAction(api.people.semanticSearch)`, 300ms debounce, min 3 characters, stale-guarded by a `cancelled` flag, `.catch(() => setSemantic([]))`.
Server (`convex/people.ts:2084-2187`): `requireUser`, rate limit 30/min, `embedText(term)`, then **two** `ctx.vectorSearch` calls in parallel over `people.by_embedding` and `memories.by_embedding` filtered by `userId`; both thresholded on `MIN_SEMANTIC_SCORE`; best score wins per person with the matching memory line attached as `evidence` (`searchResultValidator:2022-2038`).
**Gap:** the silent catch means a rate-limit rejection or embedding failure is indistinguishable from "no meaning matches" — the amber `memory` tag simply never appears and the user is told nothing. Also: `evidence` is returned by the server but **never rendered** in `SearchAdd.tsx`; the UI only shows the `memory` tag.

**Full list of Convex functions called from `src/`:**
`people.searchPeople` ×2, `people.listPersonNames`, `people.getPerson`, `people.addPersonWithOutcome`, `people.semanticSearch`, `people.updatePerson`, `people.deletePerson`, `sharedNotes.getForPerson`, `sharedNotes.updateForPerson`, `captures.listCaptures` / `generateUploadUrl` / `createCapture` / `acceptCapture` / `acceptManualCapture` / `discardCapture` / `retryExtract`, `profiles.getByHandle`, `waitlist.joinWaitlist`.
Notably **not** called from web: `people.ask` (the LLM Q&A — backend + eval fixtures exist, no web surface), `profiles.connect`, `profiles.setUsername`, `loveAlarm.*`, `people.listPeople`, `people.searchDirectory` (iOS-only paths).

## 5. WAITLIST

**Route:** no dedicated route — the form lives inside `IosPage` (`#/ios`, alias `#/join`). Component `src/WaitlistForm.tsx` (182 lines), copy in `src/waitlistCopy.ts`.

**Flow** (`WaitlistForm.tsx:60-89`): one calm line (name + Join); focusing/typing the name unfolds the email row (`revealed`, `:44, 126-130`), and the two Join buttons swap via `inert` (`:139, 144`) so only one is ever in the tab order. Validation is name-first then email (`isValidEmail`, `lib.ts:102-106`) so the first error shown is the first thing to fix. `mode` is `desktop|phone` from a live 620px viewport check (`:22-28, 52-58`) and is **a device signal only** — `waitlistCopy.ts:1-6` warns copy must never key off it, and `waitlistCopy.test.ts` locks that.

**Server** — `convex/waitlist.ts:25-72`, a **public, unauthenticated mutation**:
- **Rate limit first**, before validation, so invalid attempts also count: `MAX_JOINS_PER_MINUTE = 40`, 60s fixed window, on a **single global sentinel key** `"public:waitlist"` (`:14-16, 35-41`). No per-user or per-IP dimension — the comment acknowledges a genuine burst past 40/min is briefly turned away.
- Re-validates and normalizes server-side (`normalizeEmail`, `isValidEmail` — imported from `src/lib.ts`, so client and server share one definition).
- Dedupes on `by_email`; an existing row returns `{status:"already"}` with **no new row and no second email** (`:53-59`).
- **Stored:** exactly `{name, email, source}` where `source ∈ {"desktop","phone"}` (`:61`). No IP, no user-agent, no timestamp beyond Convex's `_creationTime`.
- Confirmation email is **scheduled, not awaited** (`:66-69`), and `sendConfirmationEmail` swallows every failure (`:77-104`) so a Resend outage never rolls back a join.

**Client outcome handling** (`:78, 91-109`): `already` is a first-class success state with its own copy, never faked as a fresh join — so the UI never promises an email that won't come, and the endpoint never leaks whether an address was seen before.

## 7. STATE / DATA

- **Convex React hooks:** `useQuery` (live subscriptions), `useMutation`, `useAction`, `useConvex`, `useConvexAuth`. Full call list in item 3. All app queries are **live** — every screen re-renders on server change.
- **Optimistic updates: zero.** `grep withOptimisticUpdate src/` returns nothing. The codebase relies entirely on live-query invalidation; e.g. `PersonDetail.tsx:203-205` — *"The search screen's live query drops the row on its own."* CaptureTriage instead fakes latency-hiding with an animation: the card flies off on a 340ms timer while the mutation is still in flight, and is explicitly brought back on rejection (`CaptureTriage.tsx:263-282`).
- **localStorage: exactly one key** — `"haven:hasSession"` (`App.tsx:228-245`). Written when auth resolves signed-in, removed when it resolves signed-out; read once at first paint so a returning visitor sees a splash instead of a flash of landing. Both read and write are `try`/`catch`ed for private mode, degrading to "no hint". No `sessionStorage`, no `document.cookie` in `src/`.
- **Snapshot-first pattern:** `PersonSnapshot` (`lib.ts:19-41`) carries whole projected rows from `searchPeople` into `PersonDetail` so the view-transition name morph settles without a late reflow — the type comment at `:12-18` explains the optional wide half is load-bearing, not generosity.
- Ephemeral UI state (drafts, drag, errors) is plain `useState`; no Redux/Zustand/Context beyond the two providers.

## 8. TESTS

**Config quirk worth naming.** `vitest.config.ts` sets `environment: "edge-runtime"` globally, and `projects[0]` (confusingly named `"convex"`) has **no `include`**, so it picks up the default glob and is what actually runs all 13 `src/*.test.tsx` files. Each is rescued individually by a `// @vitest-environment happy-dom` docblock on line 1. `happy-dom` is a devDependency **never named in `vitest.config.ts`**. Fragility: a new `.test.tsx` added without that docblock runs under edge-runtime and fails obscurely. `projects[1]` isolates `convex/people.test.ts` + `memories.test.ts` into a single fork with `groupOrder:1` to dodge a convex-test scheduler race.

**Mocking approach** (representative: `SearchAdd.test.tsx:15-43`): `vi.mock("convex/react")` replacing the whole module with `vi.hoisted` ref cells. Queries are disambiguated **by args shape** — `"query" in args ? people.current : suggestionPool.current` — which is how the S7 test can starve `searchPeople` while feeding `listPersonNames`. Mutations record `saved.args` and return a settable `addPersonResult`. Rendering via `@testing-library/react`. No MSW, no real Convex client, no network.

**Coverage by kind:**
- *Pure logic:* `lib.test.ts` (1085 lines, 20 describes — `resolveView` routing matrix, all four hash predicates, `bootMode`, `deriveProfileUrl`, `buildEmbedText`, `buildDossier`, `decideSwipe`, `triageCountLabel`), `sky.test.ts` (seeded-determinism + cross-identity invariants), `reach.test.ts` (503 lines, 10 describes), `nameSuggestion.test.ts` (new), `lens.test.ts`, `landing2Geometry.test.ts`.
- *Component:* `SearchAdd`, `PersonDetail`, `CardPage`, `LandingPage`, `Landing2Page`, `IosPage`, `SkyPage`, `SupportPage`, `TopNav`, `Footer`, `WaitlistForm`, `SkyDemoEmbed`, `ErrorBoundary`.
- *Config/artifact tests — unusual and valuable:* `contentSecurityPolicy.test.ts` (200 lines) parses `vercel.json`'s CSP and asserts every required host, and builds a real `RegExp` from the committed `source` to check the demo-sky carve-out behaves rather than string-matching itself; `appSiteAssociation.test.ts`, `vercelBuildSkip.test.ts`, `clerkConfig.test.ts`, `seo.test.ts`, `brandAssets.test.ts`, `designTokens.test.ts`, `iosProjectSettings.test.ts`, `driftSkyCanvasSizing.test.ts`.
- *Cross-platform parity:* `reach.test.ts:270` "the iOS file this mirrors" and `PersonDetail.test.tsx:429` "the iOS screen this mirrors" read the Swift sources and assert the two implementations agree.

**New tests in the working tree:** `nameSuggestion.test.ts` (entirely new, 199 lines); `SearchAdd.test.tsx:296-442` "Same person? while typing a name" (7 tests incl. the S7 starved-search case and the pick-then-rename-clears-the-attach case); `reach.test.ts` +146 lines (X platformId links, E.164 folding, LinkedIn staleness); `PersonDetail.test.tsx` +62 lines (4 staleness-hint tests).

- **Stale docstring** contradicting its own commit: `nameSuggestion.ts:83-85` vs `SearchAdd.tsx:161-167` (see item 3).

---

## 10. ANALYTICS / TRACKING

**No analytics or tracking of any kind.** Confirmed four independent ways:

1. **No SDK anywhere.** Grep across `src/`, `index.html`, `public/demo-sky.html`, `vercel.json` for `gtag|analytics|posthog|plausible|segment|mixpanel|fbq|hotjar|clarity|umami|amplitude|datadog|sentry` returns only two false positives: `LegalPage.tsx:99` (the claim itself) and a comment containing "plausible" in `nameSuggestion.test.ts:94`. No `@vercel/analytics`, no `@vercel/speed-insights` in `package.json`.
2. **CSP enforces it.** `vercel.json` `script-src 'self' https://valued-bonefish-64.clerk.accounts.dev https://clerk.inhavens.com` — no analytics origin can execute even if added. `connect-src` is likewise an explicit allowlist (two Convex deployments, two Clerk hosts, one feedback service). Enforced (not Report-Only) and asserted by `contentSecurityPolicy.test.ts`.
3. **No `<script>` beyond the app bundle** in `index.html` — one `application/ld+json` Organization/WebSite block (`:27-49`) and `<script type="module" src="/src/main.tsx">`.
4. **The privacy policy's "No analytics SDKs" claim (`LegalPage.tsx:99`) is accurate as written.**

**The one third-party runtime surface that does exist:** `FeedbackWidget.tsx` dynamic-imports `feedback-sdk-widget` inside an effect (`:17-20`) and renders a `<feedback-widget>` custom element. It is triple-gated — admin-only via `useIsAdmin`, plus both `VITE_FEEDBACK_ENDPOINT` and `VITE_FEEDBACK_TOKEN` must be set (`:15`) — mounted only in the signed-in `Home` (`App.tsx:211`), and posts to `https://glorious-gerbil-332.convex.site`, pinned in the CSP `connect-src` and asserted in `contentSecurityPolicy.test.ts:37`. It is an author-facing feedback channel, not visitor telemetry.

**Adjacent hardening in `vercel.json`:** `X-Frame-Options: DENY` (`SAMEORIGIN` only for `/demo-sky.html`, which also gets its own tighter `form-action 'none'` policy), `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, `Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()` — the last of which enforces at the header level what `webScope.test.ts:74-87` enforces at the source level.

**`public/` inventory** (binaries not read): `og.png` (84 KB social card, generated by `scripts/generate-brand-assets.py` from `brand/nori.png`), `downloads/YourSky.zip` (469 KB — **modified in the working tree**, was 512 KB), `demo-sky.html` (176 KB self-contained 3D graph prototype, header states all data is synthetic with a seeded RNG and no real names/numbers/messages), icon set (favicon 16/32/ico, apple-touch, 192/512/maskable-512), `manifest.webmanifest`, `robots.txt` (`Allow: /` + sitemap), `sitemap.xml` (root + support/privacy/terms only — card pages deliberately excluded), `.well-known/apple-app-site-association` (universal links; ~45 explicit path exclusions then `/*` = "everything else at the root is somebody's card"; **note the appID is still the placeholder `TEAMIDXXXX.com.inhavens.haven`**), `google017f01b86b15816f.html` (Search Console verification).

I have everything. Here is the audit.

---

# Haven web frontend — working-tree audit
**Repo** `/Users/minhthiennguyen/Desktop/Euno/euno-app` · **branch** `feat/identity-foundation` · **pkg** `haven-app@0.48.0` · **stack** Vite 7 + React 19 + Convex + Clerk, deployed on Vercel

Frontend files with uncommitted changes (the "current dev version"): `src/SearchAdd.tsx`, `src/PersonDetail.tsx`, `src/CardPage.tsx`, `src/reach.ts`, `src/index.css` (+84 lines), their tests, `vitest.config.ts`, plus **two untracked new files** — `src/nameSuggestion.ts` and `src/nameSuggestion.test.ts`. That untracked pair is the crux of item 3 and is addressed there.

---

## 1. ROUTING

There is **no router library**. One pure function, `resolveView`, decides the whole top-level screen.

**Resolver:** `src/lib.ts:559-598`. Inputs: `{isAuthenticated, isLoading, hash, hasSessionHint, pathname}`. `View` union at `src/lib.ts:499-509`. Rendered by `src/App.tsx:275-297`.

Precedence, in the order the code checks:

| # | Check | Source | View | Auth |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `sitePageFromPath === "support"` → `/support` | `lib.ts:545-548, 572-573` | `SupportPage` | public |
| 2 | `sitePageFromPath` ∈ `privacy`\|`terms` | `lib.ts:541-557, 574` | `LegalPage` | public |
| 3 | `handleFromPath(pathname) !== null` → `/<handle>` | `lib.ts:527-531, 580` | `CardPage` | public, **checked before auth deliberately** |
| 4 | `isAuthenticated` | `lib.ts:581` | `Home` | signed in |
| 5 | `isAuthPath` — `/signin`, `/sign-in`, `/signup`, `/sign-up`, `/login` + sub-paths | `lib.ts:467-473, 584` | `SignIn` | public |
| 6 | `#/sky` (trailing slash tolerated) | `lib.ts:118-120, 588` | `SkyPage` | public |
| 7 | `#/ios` **or** `#/join` (alias) | `lib.ts:111-128, 591` | `IosPage` (carries waitlist) | public |
| 8 | `#/landing2` | `lib.ts:135-137, 594` | `Landing2Page` | public, **unlinked** |
| 9 | any other `#/…` (Clerk flow, e.g. `#/sso-callback`) | `lib.ts:454-456, 595` | `SignIn` | public |
| 10 | `isLoading && bootMode==="splash"` | `lib.ts:481-488, 596` | `Splash` | returning visitor |
| 11 | fallback | `lib.ts:597` | `LandingPage` (root `/`) | public |

Notes:
- There is **no `/landing` path route**. The brief's "/landing" does not exist; the root `/` *is* the landing (`LandingPage`), and the experimental second concept is `#/landing2`.
- There is **no standalone waitlist route**. `#/join` is kept only as an alias that lands on `IosPage` (`lib.ts:496-498, 591`).
- Path routes only work because of the SPA rewrite `"/((?!api/|assets/)[^.]+)" → /index.html` in `vercel.json`.
- Hash is tracked live via `hashchange` (`App.tsx:252-257`); `pathname` is read **once** at mount (`App.tsx:271-273`) because nothing in-app navigates between paths.
- Signed-in sub-navigation is local component state, not routing: `Screen = search | capture | detail` at `App.tsx:89-92`, transitions wrapped in `document.startViewTransition` via `withScreenTransition` (`App.tsx:96-115`), with a shared-element name morph (`viewTransitionName: "person-name"`, `SearchAdd.tsx:665-671`).

---

## 2. WHAT A SIGNED-IN WEB USER CAN DO

`Home` (`App.tsx:117-214`) renders its own header (brand + **Sign out**, or **Back**), a scroll sentinel for the frosted-header state, one of three screens, and `<FeedbackWidget/>`.

### 2a. `SearchAdd.tsx` — "the Atlas", the signed-in home (722 lines)
Despite the filename it is a full-viewport constellation field, not a list.

**Data** (`SearchAdd.tsx:156-175`): four Convex subscriptions/handles —
- `api.people.searchPeople {query:""}` — the stable recent field (server-capped 20, `RESULT_LIMIT` mirrored client-side at `:29`)
- `api.people.searchPeople {query}` — the live name search
- `api.people.listPersonNames {}` — the typo-suggester's pool (**new in working tree**)
- `api.people.addPersonWithOutcome` mutation, `api.people.semanticSearch` action, plus a raw `useConvex()` for a one-shot `getPerson`.

**Field composition** (`:253-282`): `composeAtlasField(recent, nameMatches, semantic)` (`lib.ts:432-448`) — recent first so spiral positions never shift, then off-field name matches, then semantic-only. Layout `atlasLayout` + per-person `buildCluster(p._id, …)` seeded by document id so the star survives a rename (`:265-273`, `sky.ts`). A shared dust field renders as 3 group-shimmer layers (`:443-470`).

**Search behaviour**: typing dims non-matching clusters rather than removing them (`isLit`, `:287-288`); everyone stays lit while the query subscription re-resolves so the sky never flashes. Semantic-only hits get an amber halo and a literal `memory` tag (`isMemory`, `:290-294`, `:678`).

**Add flow** (`:296-434`): no exact name match ⇒ `Add "<name>" to your sky` (`:539-543`). One tap expands an inline form: platform `<select>` from `REACH_PLATFORMS` (`:551-565`), handle field (`@` prefix suppressed and `inputMode="tel"` for phone/whatsapp, `:329, 569-582`), and a required "How you met" note. Submit path `handleAdd` (`:358-424`):
1. `reachValue(platform, handle)` folds a pasted URL/number down to a handle; `null` ⇒ inline error naming the platform (`:373-378`).
2. Both handle and note required (`:366-369`).
3. Calls `addPersonWithOutcome({name, contactHandles:[…], context, attachToPersonId})`.
4. **Outcome handling** (`:394-416`) — four statuses: `created` (typed name is the name), `attached`/`already` (handle already owned; the real name is re-fetched via `convex.query(getPerson)` before opening, so a wrong name never flashes), `conflict` (nothing written, form stays open, two distinct messages depending on whether a suggestion was picked).

**"Same person?" suggester** (`:310-313`, `:509-537`) — **new in the working tree**, covered in item 3.

**Empty / cap states**: empty sky → "No one here yet / Meet someone worth remembering, then capture them" + capture CTA (`:686-697`); at the 20-person cap → "search to find everyone else" (`:707-709`); a 300ms-delayed "reading your sky" status (`:227-234, 700-704`).

### 2b. `PersonDetail.tsx` — one person (518 lines)
**Data** (`:62-66`): `people.getPerson`, `sharedNotes.getForPerson`, and mutations `updatePerson`, `sharedNotes.updateForPerson`, `deletePerson`. Renders instantly from the snapshot handed over by the tap, then the live doc wins (`:113`), syncing the form only while not `dirty` (`:99-110`).

**Shown (read-only, from the server projection)**: seeded starfield band (`PersonSky seed={id}`, `:221`), photo with a failed-URL guard that keys on the URL not a boolean (`:87, 224-234`), name, `detailLine` = role/company | city (`:21-37`), connection state (`Connected` / `No longer connected`, `:237-249`), "Added <Month Year>", headline-or-bio (`:157, 254`), and a frozen-card notice when a connection ended (`:256-263`).

**"Ways to reach them"** (`:278-330`): preferred platform first via `samePlatform` (case-folding, `:148-151`), `reachUrl` per row, `tel:` opens in place while `https:` gets `target=_blank rel=noopener noreferrer` (`:286, 310-311`). Unopenable handles still render as plain text — deliberately different from the public card, which drops them. **New in working tree:** `platformId` passed through (X permanent-id links) and a LinkedIn staleness hint "Saved a while ago -- still the right link?" (`:283, 320-324`).

**Editable**: exactly two fields — **Link** (with an "Open ↗" affordance when `normalizeUrl` succeeds, `:332-362`) and **What you remember** (textarea, `aria-describedby` hint "One line per thing. Each is searchable on its own.", `:363-385`). Save calls `updatePerson` and navigates back (`:160-175`). Empty strings are sent as `undefined`.

**Shared notes** (`:409-466`): a second textarea, only when `sharedNotes.getForPerson` returns non-null (i.e. a mutual connection); otherwise "Available after you and {name} both connect in Haven." Status line distinguishes "Last updated by you" vs "Last updated by {name}".

**Deletion** (`:468-515`): "Remove from your network" → inline confirm ("Remove {name}? This cannot be undone.") with focus caught on **Cancel** (`:91-95`), then `deletePerson({personId})`.

**Partial / reserved:** `:265-271` is the one substantive deferred feature — a slot for the source-screenshot thumbnail, blocked because `getPerson` projects `screenshotId` but resolves only `photoUrl` to a URL. Confirmed at the source: `convex/people.ts:108` (`screenshotId` raw) vs `:116` (`photoUrl` resolved).

### 2c. `CaptureTriage.tsx` — screenshot triage (829 lines), reachable via "Capture someone new"
Not named in the brief but it is the largest app screen. Uploads via `captures.generateUploadUrl` → `POST` to Convex storage → `captures.createCapture`, each file isolated so one bad file doesn't void a batch (`:34-57, 170-187`). A swipeable card deck (oldest first, `:121`) with pointer-capture drag, rubber-banding, and velocity projection (`decideSwipe`, `lib.ts:637-650`): **fling left = Save**, **fling right = Add context**. Three card states: `pending` (reading skeleton), `ready` (extracted name/platform/handle/bio → `acceptCapture`), `failed` (manual naming — first/last/work/school → `acceptManualCapture`, plus "Retry reading"). A revealing detail at `:146`: *"with the dead OCR key every capture fails, so that is the common case"* — the automatic extraction path is effectively non-functional in this environment, making manual naming the default.

### 2d. `CardPage.tsx` — the public card (134 lines)
**Public, signed-out, and the only Convex call in `src/` with no `requireUser`.** `useQuery(api.profiles.getByHandle, {handle})` (`:13`).

- **Addressed by handle, not id**: `inhavens.com/<handle>`. Chain: `handleFromPath` → `topLevelSegment` (rejects multi-segment paths, `lib.ts:517-520`) → `isClaimableHandle` = `HANDLE_PATTERN && !isReservedHandle` (`convex/handleNames.ts:82-84`). Resolved **before** the auth check so a stranger is never bounced to a splash (`lib.ts:576-580`).
- **What it exposes** — `publicCardValidator` (`convex/profiles.ts:85-95`): `handle`, `name`, `photoUrl`, `city`, `handles`, `primaryPlatform`. `handles` is typed `publicHandleValidator` (`convex/profileFields.ts:35-43`) which admits **only instagram / x / linkedin** — phone has no member, so a leaked number is structurally impossible, not merely unlikely. The client re-guards anyway (`CardPage.tsx:93`).
- Handles with no openable URL are **dropped** (`:98-102`) rather than printed. If `primaryPlatform` names a stripped platform, the page shows "The rest is on Haven." (`:63-64, 122-126`).
- States: `undefined` = "Loading"; `null` = "Nobody here / There is no Haven card at this address" + "What is Haven?" (`:27-49`). `document.title` set to `<name> on Haven` (`:19-22`). Starfield seeded by **handle only**, never the display name, so a rename doesn't remint the constellation (`:69-73`).

### 2e. `TopNav` — public pages only (22 lines)
`src/TopNav.tsx`: wordmark → `/`, plus `#/sky` "Your Sky", `#/ios` "iPhone", `#/sign-in` "Sign in". Used by `LandingPage`, `SkyPage`, `IosPage`. **Not** used signed-in (that header is inline in `App.tsx:163-179`) and **not** on `Landing2Page` (deliberately chromeless, `Landing2Page.tsx:35-36`).

### 2f. Constellation viewer
Three layers, all pure/seeded: `sky.ts` (`buildSky`/`buildCluster`/`buildDust`/`atlasLayout`; FNV-1a hash + mulberry32, `sky.ts:48-60`; explicitly the signature `ios/Haven/SkyGenerator.swift` ports), `PersonSky.tsx` (memoized SVG, ~190 nodes, minors split into 3 shimmer layers), and `DriftSky.tsx` + `lens.ts` (canvas parallax drift with a constellation "lens" that wanders on its own and follows a fine pointer; reduced-motion kills both). `SkyDemoEmbed.tsx` is a separate thing: a click-to-activate iframe of the static `/demo-sky.html`.

---

## 3. SEARCH ON WEB

**Three genuinely distinct mechanisms, all live. It is not "only exact/fuzzy name matching."**

**(a) Server text search** — `useQuery(api.people.searchPeople,{query})`. Server (`convex/people.ts:975-998`) folds via `normalizeName`, then `withSearchIndex("search_normalized_name")` scoped by `userId`, capped at `RESULT_LIMIT` (20). Empty/punctuation-only queries fall back to the recent list.

**(b) Client-side typo matching** — `src/nameSuggestion.ts` (**untracked / new**).
- `levenshtein` (`:25-47`): classic (not Damerau), two-row DP, iterates **Unicode code points** via `Array.from` so astral characters count once.
- `MINIMUM_FUZZY_LENGTH = 4` (`:56`); `distanceLimit` (`:62-66`): `<4` → 0 (exact only), `<8` → 1, else 2. Rationale given: at 2-3 letters a distance of 1-2 reaches nearly every other short name.
- `nameSuggestions` (`:86-122`): exact matches first, then close; early-exits on length difference (Levenshtein ≥ |Δlen|); returns ≤5. Shares `normalizeName` with `convex/nameSearch.ts`, so "close" means the same fold the search index and `personHandles` use.

**Verdict on "typo suggestions reportedly non-functional against the real backend":** that describes the **pre-diff state, where the web suggester did not exist at all**. In the working tree it is **implemented and functional**. Evidence chain:
1. `nameSuggestion.ts` is untracked → brand new.
2. `git diff src/SearchAdd.tsx` shows the suggester, the `suggestionPool` query, `attachTo` state, and `addPerson` switching from `api.people.addPerson` → `api.people.addPersonWithOutcome`, all added in this diff.
3. The backing query **exists and is registered**: `convex/people.ts:951-973`, returning `{_id, name, contactHandles}` per person — so `disambiguator` (`SearchAdd.tsx:111-119`) has real data.
4. `CHANGELOG.md` v0.48.0 → **Web** bullet 1 describes exactly this shipping.

Two real caveats worth recording:
- **Scale ceiling, documented as such:** `SUGGESTION_POOL_LIMIT = 2000` with `.take()` (`convex/people.ts:943, 966`). Above 2000 people the pool truncates silently; the comment names pagination as the fix. Design choice, not a defect.
- **Stale docstring, same-commit contradiction:** `nameSuggestion.ts:83-85` says *"SearchAdd passes the live name-search results, not a full directory scan, so a person the server's own search index does not surface for this query cannot be suggested here either."* That is flatly contradicted by `SearchAdd.tsx:167` and by SearchAdd's own comment at `:161-166`, which explain that using `nameMatches` was precisely the bug (S7) and that `listPersonNames` replaced it. A reader taking the docstring at face value would conclude the S7 fix isn't there.

**(c) Real semantic / natural-language search** — yes, it exists on web and it is not mocked.
Client (`SearchAdd.tsx:175, 199-218`): `useAction(api.people.semanticSearch)`, 300ms debounce, min 3 characters, stale-guarded by a `cancelled` flag, `.catch(() => setSemantic([]))`.
Server (`convex/people.ts:2084-2187`): `requireUser`, rate limit 30/min, `embedText(term)`, then **two** `ctx.vectorSearch` calls in parallel over `people.by_embedding` and `memories.by_embedding` filtered by `userId`; both thresholded on `MIN_SEMANTIC_SCORE`; best score wins per person with the matching memory line attached as `evidence` (`searchResultValidator:2022-2038`).
**Gap:** the silent catch means a rate-limit rejection or embedding failure is indistinguishable from "no meaning matches" — the amber `memory` tag simply never appears and the user is told nothing. Also: `evidence` is returned by the server but **never rendered** in `SearchAdd.tsx`; the UI only shows the `memory` tag.

**Full list of Convex functions called from `src/`:**
`people.searchPeople` ×2, `people.listPersonNames`, `people.getPerson`, `people.addPersonWithOutcome`, `people.semanticSearch`, `people.updatePerson`, `people.deletePerson`, `sharedNotes.getForPerson`, `sharedNotes.updateForPerson`, `captures.listCaptures` / `generateUploadUrl` / `createCapture` / `acceptCapture` / `acceptManualCapture` / `discardCapture` / `retryExtract`, `profiles.getByHandle`, `waitlist.joinWaitlist`.
Notably **not** called from web: `people.ask` (the LLM Q&A — backend + eval fixtures exist, no web surface), `profiles.connect`, `profiles.setUsername`, `loveAlarm.*`, `people.listPeople`, `people.searchDirectory` (iOS-only paths).

---

## 4. AUTH

Clerk via `@clerk/react` ^6.12.5. `main.tsx:14-31`: `ErrorBoundary → ClerkProvider → ConvexProviderWithClerk → App`. Keys from `VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` / `VITE_CONVEX_URL`.

`clerkConfig.ts` documents a production-only redirect loop (Clerk's Account Portal advertising `accounts.inhavens.com/sign-in`, bouncing back forever) and applies **two** independent fixes: explicit `signInUrl`/`signUpUrl` (`:34-41`) and `routing:"hash"` (`:48`). `clerkAppearance.ts` maps Clerk's modal onto the app's CSS variables.

**Sign-in UX** (`App.tsx:45-87`): the signed-out door is Haven's own sky with a glass button; Clerk's card mounts only on tap — **except** when `isClerkFlowHash` is already true (returning from OAuth), which mounts it immediately so the handshake isn't dropped. `SkyLanding busy` doubles as Clerk's `fallback`, so an early tap is never a dead click.

**Auth gate:** `useConvexAuth()` (`App.tsx:248`). Only **`home`** requires authentication. Public views: `landing`, `landing2`, `signin`, `card`, `legal` (privacy/terms), `support`, `sky`, `ios`, `splash`. The rationale is explicit and load-bearing: App Review opens `/privacy` and `/support` with no session (`lib.ts:568-573`), and a stranger scanning a beacon arrives signed out (`lib.ts:576-579`).

**Admin gate:** `useIsAdmin.ts` reads `user.primaryEmailAddress` against `parseAdminEmails(VITE_ADMIN_EMAILS)` merged with `DEFAULT_ADMIN_EMAILS`. The file self-documents at `:12-13`: *"This is a UX gate, not a security boundary."* Its only consumer is `FeedbackWidget`. **Compliance flag: `src/lib.ts:74` hardcodes a real personal Gmail address as the baked-in admin default** (not reproduced here). It is not a credential and the surface it gates is cosmetic, but it is a real personal identifier committed in source.

---

## 5. WAITLIST

**Route:** no dedicated route — the form lives inside `IosPage` (`#/ios`, alias `#/join`). Component `src/WaitlistForm.tsx` (182 lines), copy in `src/waitlistCopy.ts`.

**Flow** (`WaitlistForm.tsx:60-89`): one calm line (name + Join); focusing/typing the name unfolds the email row (`revealed`, `:44, 126-130`), and the two Join buttons swap via `inert` (`:139, 144`) so only one is ever in the tab order. Validation is name-first then email (`isValidEmail`, `lib.ts:102-106`) so the first error shown is the first thing to fix. `mode` is `desktop|phone` from a live 620px viewport check (`:22-28, 52-58`) and is **a device signal only** — `waitlistCopy.ts:1-6` warns copy must never key off it, and `waitlistCopy.test.ts` locks that.

**Server** — `convex/waitlist.ts:25-72`, a **public, unauthenticated mutation**:
- **Rate limit first**, before validation, so invalid attempts also count: `MAX_JOINS_PER_MINUTE = 40`, 60s fixed window, on a **single global sentinel key** `"public:waitlist"` (`:14-16, 35-41`). No per-user or per-IP dimension — the comment acknowledges a genuine burst past 40/min is briefly turned away.
- Re-validates and normalizes server-side (`normalizeEmail`, `isValidEmail` — imported from `src/lib.ts`, so client and server share one definition).
- Dedupes on `by_email`; an existing row returns `{status:"already"}` with **no new row and no second email** (`:53-59`).
